**Answer: 1/5**

This relies on recalled literature rather than a full derivation. I recall that Letzter and Snyder showed the homomorphism threshold of {C₃, C₅}-free graphs is at most 1/5, and I believe a later sharpening shows it equals 1/5. I did not verify the matching lower-bound construction here.

The property in the problem is exactly the homomorphism threshold δ_hom(C₃, C₅): the infimum of c for which {C₃, C₅}-free graphs with minimum degree at least cn are homomorphic to some bounded-size C₃-free graph.

ANSWER: 1/5
